reports.summary_en: Russia commissioned an assassination attempt against a Ukrainian rapper in Denmark, following an earlier attempt in Warsaw.
reports.summary_sk: Rusko si objednalo atentát na ukrajinského mecenáša a rappera v Dánsku, pričom predtým sa o to pokúsilo vo Varšave.

reports.summary_en: Denmark accused Russia of plotting to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper and expelled Russia's defence attaché; the Russian embassy denies the allegation.
reports.summary_sk: Dánsko obvinilo Rusko zo sprisahania s cieľom zavraždiť americko-ukrajinského rapera a vyhostilo ruského vojenského pridelenca; ruské veľvyslanectvo obvinenie poprelo.

reports.summary_en: Denmark expels an attaché over an alleged attack plot against a Kyivstoner, a suspected Russian-linked operation.
reports.summary_sk: Dánsko vyhostilo diplomata v súvislosti s údajne plánovaným útokom na kyjevského streamera.

reports.summary_en: Von der Leyen condemned an alleged Russian intelligence-orchestrated assassination plot against a US-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark and pledged a new EU security strategy.
reports.summary_sk: Predsedníčka Európskej komisie Ursula von der Leyenová odsúdila údajné sprisahanie proti americko-ukrajinskému občanovi v Dánsku, ktoré mala zorganizovať ruská spravodajská služba, a sľúbila novú bezpečnostnú stratégiu EÚ.

reports.summary_en: Ursula von der Leyen condemned an assassination attempt in Denmark on a US-Ukrainian citizen, attributed to Russia.
reports.summary_sk: Ursula von der Leyenová odsúdila pokus o atentát na americko-ukrajinského občana v Dánsku, ktorý sa pripisuje Rusku.

reports.summary_en: Denmark has expelled a Russian attaché over a foiled plot to kill a rapper.

reports.summary_en: After a foiled assassination attempt in Copenhagen on a Ukrainian rapper, Denmark urges the EU to take a joint approach against Russia, including tough visa restrictions for Russians.

reports.summary_en: Donald Tusk confirmed that the object that fell in Poland originated from Russia, describing the airspace breach as a possible intentional provocation.

reports.summary_en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated a Russian missile hitting Poland during Western military exercises in the region did not appear to be an accident.
reports.summary_sk: Poľský premiér Donald Tusk vyhlásil, že dopad ruskej rakety v Poľsku počas vojenských cvičení západných spojencov v regióne nevyzerá ako náhoda.

reports.summary_en: Donald Tusk said it seems Russia deliberately violated Polish airspace, adding that no damage or casualties were recorded.
reports.summary_sk: Donald Tusk uviedol, že sa zdá, že Rusko úmyselne narušilo poľský vzdušný priestor, pričom doplnil, že neboli zaznamenané žiadne škody ani obete.

reports.summary_en: Polish media report that Russian missiles and a drone fell on Polish territory, emphasizing the incident’s significance for NATO and Ukraine support.
reports.summary_sk: Poľské médiá informujú, že na území Poľska spadli ruské rakety a dron, pričom zdôrazňujú význam incidentu pre NATO a podporu Ukrajiny.

reports.summary_en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said the recent Russian cruise missile incursion into Poland's airspace appeared intentional, noting no damage or casualties.
reports.summary_sk: Poľský premiér Donald Tusk uviedol, že nedávny ruský prelet raketou cez poľské vzdušné priestory vyzerá úmyselne, pričom neboli zaznamenané žiadne škody ani obete.

reports.summary_en: Polish authorities reported that two missiles and a drone originating from Russia likely landed in Poland near military exercise sites, causing no casualties or damage.

reports.summary_en: Polish prosecutors are working at three sites where Russian objects fell, with Nowy Lipowiec posing the greatest pyrotechnic risk, as services recover debris and secure evidence.
reports.summary_sk: Poľská prokuratúra vykonáva úkony na troch miestach dopadu ruských objektov, pričom v Nowom Lipowci je najväčšie pyrotechnické riziko; zložky vyberajú trosky a zabezpečujú dôkazy.

reports.summary_en: NATO chief Mark Rutte flew to Warsaw after three Russian aerial objects crashed in south-eastern Poland on Friday, which Tusk called a deliberate provocation; Rutte said NATO is ready to protect its members.
reports.summary_sk: Generálny tajomník NATO Mark Rutte pricestoval do Varšavy po tom, čo sa v piatok na juhovýchode Poľska zrútili tri ruské vzdušné objekty, čo Tusk označil za zámernú provokáciu; Rutte uistil, že Aliancia je pripravená chrániť svojich členov.

reports.summary_en: Prosecutors say remains of Russian Kh-101 missiles were found in Poland, and preliminary identification refuted initial reports that one of the objects could have been a jet-powered drone.

reports.summary_en: All three Russian-made objects that fell on Polish territory after violating its airspace during a Russian attack on Ukraine were Kh-101 cruise missiles, officials announced on Sunday.

reports.summary_en: Objects that crashed in Poland were Russian missiles, Austrian broadcaster ORF reports.
